title: Steganographic Side-Channel Detector for Two-Agent Chats

original_idea.body: # Steganographic Side-Channel Detector for Two-Agent Chats

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: text-only collusion detection is a deployable lab-independent tool against a recognized multi-agent threat.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: collusion game + statistical/paraphrase-invariance detectors, inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (detector AUROC vs activation baseline), two detector types add scope.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected: text-only (no activation access) detector is exactly what non-lab orgs need.

novelty.reasoning: Activation-based detection exists; text-only behavioral detector may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Purely behavioral text-only collusion detector likely missing.
